content_sections.heading: Kashmir University Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
Kashmir University Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Kashmir University Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the Kashmir University recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Kashmir University recruitment is Senior Research Fellow. This is a contractual position within the university.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow post in this recruitment drive by Kashmir University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,400 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Clinical Biochemistry, or a related discipline, and have cleared NET/SET/GATE with at least two years of relevant research experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit mentioned for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q7. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Senior Research Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Walk-in Interview venue?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the Kashmir University office in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 190006.
